description: Real operating data of a photovoltaic system installed at Area Science Park - Trieste - Italy is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors ALESSANDRINI STEFANO (AREA SCIENCE PARK). Data collected from a monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) plant installed on building Q2 at Area Science Park in the Basovizza campus located in Trieste, Italy. The data represent almost 9 years of real operating conditions of the PV plant. Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
